requirements.requirement: FixtureSpec validates units, bounds, and coupled feasibility constraints before geometry construction.
requirements.acceptance: Reject negative, nonfinite, out-of-range, and impossible pitch/diameter combinations with a specific explanation.

requirements.requirement: Every accepted configuration produces exactly two valid, positive-volume single solids.
requirements.acceptance: Inspect each BREP and STEP reimport in a fresh process; reject null, merged, or self-invalid geometry.

requirements.requirement: Bore, hole pitches, base thickness, and datums agree with requirements within 0.05 mm.
requirements.acceptance: Independent section/edge/plane queries of reimported STEP measure dimensions.

requirements.requirement: Sensor and connector keepouts remain clear except for explicitly intended contact surfaces.
requirements.acceptance: Boolean intersections and known collision mutations verify the rule and its exclusions.

requirements.requirement: Fastener and tool-access envelopes remain usable in the prescribed assembly sequence.
requirements.acceptance: Sampled assembly and tool sweeps identify intentional impossible-access configurations.

requirements.requirement: Wall, base, and build-volume requirements are checked on generated geometry.
requirements.acceptance: Deliberately thin or oversized parts fail even if their input metadata claims compliance.

requirements.requirement: All six reference designs pass and all eight invalid cases are rejected for their intended cause.
requirements.acceptance: Frozen inventory and explicit case-to-requirement mapping, not just counting nonzero exits.

requirements.requirement: STEP and STL export preserve units and per-part identity; round trips remain within tolerance.
requirements.acceptance: Reimport STEP, compare volume/bounds, and check STL watertightness and triangle orientation.

requirements.requirement: Offline demonstration shows a rejected candidate and a corrected fixture without a model service.
requirements.acceptance: Run without credentials and network; inspect actual generated CAD and reports.

requirements.requirement: Any generated-code experiment uses bounded isolation and a read-only evaluator.
requirements.acceptance: Timeout, path-escape, and evaluator-write probes fail; JSON-only generation cannot execute code.

requirements.requirement: Inspection output separates computed geometry from unmeasured physical fit and strength.
requirements.acceptance: Report labels geometric checks, assumptions, and absent physical tests explicitly.

requirements.requirement: Fresh installation and deterministic inputs reproduce the required artifacts within numerical tolerance.
requirements.acceptance: Record stable versions; compare geometry semantically rather than assuming STEP file bytes are invariant.
